messages.author: 47e0d105424c0088
messages.subject: Off-topic: Workflow with minted latex package in Rstudio
parts:
Stan folks,

Has someone been able to run the minted package as a substitute for the listings package  in Rstudio? 

I am having some difficulty because of the -shell-escape switch that is required with the latex execution for the minted package. Checking 'Enabling shell escape commands' in the Sweave global options does not seem to work for me. Though, the same code works for me when I compile it otherwise in Miktex. 

I would appreciate any help if someone has been successful in fixing this.

Regards,

Raghu.
